title: Bayramlar va urf-odatlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida bayram lug‘atini, to‘g‘ri predloglarni va solishtirish iboralarini ishlatib, sevimli bayramingiz va bitta ingliz bayrami haqida gapira olasiz hamda bayram tabriklarini to‘g‘ri aytasiz.

scenes.title: Bayramlar va urf-odatlar
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we talk about holidays and traditions in Britain and in your country.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda buyruq, iltimos va maslahat berishni o‘rgandik. Bugun madaniyat haqida gaplashamiz: bayramlar, urf-odatlar, inglizlar nimalarni nishonlashi va bizning bayramlarimiz bilan qanday o‘xshashlik va farqlar borligi. Dars oxirida sevimli bayramingizni va bitta ingliz bayramini inglizcha tasvirlay olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun Buyuk Britaniyadagi va sizning yurtingizdagi bayramlar va urf-odatlar haqida gaplashamiz.

scenes.title: Asosiy so‘zlar

examples.t: We celebrate New Year with our family.
examples.uz: Biz Yangi yilni oilamiz bilan nishonlaymiz.

examples.t: It is a family tradition.

scenes.say: Holiday. Celebrate. Tradition. Custom. Festival. We celebrate New Year with our family.
scenes.say_native: Boshlaymiz. “Holiday” — bayram yoki ta’til. “Celebrate” — nishonlash, bu fe’lni ko‘p ishlatamiz: “We celebrate New Year”. “Tradition” — avloddan avlodga o‘tadigan an’ana, “custom” esa jamiyatda qabul qilingan odat. Ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi, “tradition” biroz ko‘proq oila va tarixga bog‘liq. “Festival” — bayram sayli, odatda jamoa tadbiri.
scenes.say_uz: Bayram. Nishonlamoq. An’ana. Odat. Festival. Biz Yangi yilni oilamiz bilan nishonlaymiz.

scenes.title: Holiday: ikki ma’no
board: public holiday / bank holiday = dam olish kuni

examples.t: Monday is a bank holiday.
We are on holiday in Spain.

scenes.say: Monday is a bank holiday. We are on holiday in Spain. In American English: vacation.
scenes.say_native: “Holiday” so‘zining ikki ma’nosi bor, bu muhim. Birinchisi: umumxalq bayram kuni, uni “public holiday” deymiz, Britaniyada esa ko‘pincha “bank holiday”. Ikkinchisi: ta’til, masalan, “on holiday” — ta’tilda. Amerikada ta’til uchun “vacation” so‘zi ko‘proq ishlatiladi. “Happy holidays” esa bayramlar mavsumida aytiladigan umumiy tilak.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanba dam olish kuni. Biz Ispaniyada ta’tildamiz. Amerika inglizchasida: vacation.

scenes.title: Ta’rifni toping
board: 1) a day when most people do not work
2) something a family does every year
3) to have a party for a special day
scenes.say: A day when people do not work. A thing a family does every year. To have a party for a special day.
scenes.say_native: Uchta ta’rif bor. Birinchisi: ko‘pchilik odam ishlamaydigan kun. Ikkinchisi: oila har yili qiladigan narsa. Uchinchisi: maxsus kun uchun bayram qilish. Mos inglizcha so‘zlarni o‘ylang: public holiday, tradition, celebrate.
scenes.say_uz: Odamlar ishlamaydigan kun. Oila har yili qiladigan narsa. Maxsus kun uchun bayram qilish.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: A public holiday. A tradition. To celebrate. Navruz is a public holiday and a big tradition.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchisi — “a public holiday”. Ikkinchisi — “a tradition”. Uchinchisi — “to celebrate”. Sizning vaziyatingizda bu so‘zlarni birlashtirish mumkin: “Navruz is a public holiday and a big tradition”. Navruz — dam olish kuni ham, katta an’ana ham.
scenes.say_uz: Umumxalq bayrami. An’ana. Nishonlamoq. Navro‘z — dam olish kuni va katta an’ana.

scenes.title: Bayram lug‘ati

examples.t: We put up decorations.
There are fireworks at midnight.

scenes.say: Presents. Decorations. Fireworks. Costumes. A big feast. A card.
scenes.say_native: Endi bayram lug‘ati. “Present” yoki “gift” — sovg‘a. “Decorations” — bezaklar. “Fireworks” — otashbozlik, bu so‘z doim ko‘plik shaklida ishlatiladi. “Costume” — kostyum. “Feast” — katta bayram dasturxoni. “Card” — tabrik otkrytkasi. Ingliz bayramlarining deyarli hammasida shu so‘zlar uchraydi.
scenes.say_uz: Sovg‘alar. Bezaklar. Otashbozlik. Kostyumlar. Katta dasturxon. Otkrytka.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: Christmas
scenes.say: Christmas. Halloween. Easter. Celebrate.
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzga e’tibor bering. “Christmas” — “krismas”, undagi t harfi aytilmaydi, “ch” esa “k” deb o‘qiladi. “Halloween” — urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda: “hallo-WEEN”. “Easter” — “ee-ster”, birinchi bo‘g‘inda uzun i. “Celebrate” — urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: “SEL-e-brate”. Bu to‘rt so‘zni ko‘pchilik noto‘g‘ri aytadi, shuning uchun takrorlaymiz.
scenes.say_uz: Krismas. Halloween. Easter. Nishonlamoq.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say: Christmas. Halloween. Easter. Celebrate. Fireworks.
scenes.say_native: Mening ortimdan takrorlang. Christmas, Halloween, Easter, celebrate, fireworks. “Fireworks” ni “FIRE-works” deb aytasiz, urg‘u birinchi qismda. Har so‘zni ikki marta ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Krismas. Halloween. Easter. Nishonlamoq. Otashbozlik.

scenes.title: Urg‘uni tekshirish
scenes.say: Christmas. Halloween. Easter. Celebrate. Fireworks.
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. “Christmas” — urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, t harfi o‘qilmaydi. “Halloween” — urg‘u oxirida. “Easter” — birinchi bo‘g‘inda. “Celebrate” — birinchi bo‘g‘inda. “Fireworks” — birinchi qismda. Agar o‘zingizda farq sezgan bo‘lsangiz, yana bir marta takrorlang, qulog‘ingiz tezda ko‘nikadi.
scenes.say_uz: Krismas. Halloween. Easter. Nishonlamoq. Otashbozlik.

scenes.title: On, in, at bayramlar bilan
board: on + sana / kun: on 25 December, on Christmas Day
at + bayram davri: at Christmas, at Easter

examples.t: We open presents on Christmas Day.
People travel at Christmas.

scenes.say: We open presents on Christmas Day. People travel at Christmas. Christmas is in December.
scenes.say_native: Predloglarni eslaymiz. Aniq sana yoki kun bilan “on”: “on 25 December”, “on Christmas Day”. Oy bilan “in”: “in December”. Bayram davri, ya’ni bayram atrofidagi bir necha kun uchun “at”: “at Christmas”, “at Easter”. Shuning uchun “at Christmas” — Rojdestvo paytida, “on Christmas Day” esa aniq o‘sha kuni. Inglizlar sanani odatda “twenty-fifth of December” deb o‘qiydi.
scenes.say_uz: Biz sovg‘alarni Rojdestvo kuni ochamiz. Odamlar Rojdestvo paytida sayohat qiladi. Rojdestvo dekabrda.

scenes.title: Predlog xatolari
scenes.say: At Christmas. On Christmas Day. On 25 December. In December.
scenes.say_native: Tipik xato: “in Christmas” yoki “in Navruz” deyish, chunki o‘zbekchada “Navro‘zda” qo‘shimchasi hamma joyda bir xil. Inglizchada bayram davri uchun “at”: “at Christmas”, “at Navruz”. Yana “in 25 December” noto‘g‘ri, sana oldidan “on” keladi. Oy oldidan esa “in”. Uchta predlogni farqlash gapingizni darhol tabiiy qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Rojdestvo paytida. Rojdestvo kuni. Yigirma beshinchi dekabrda. Dekabrda.

scenes.title: Predlogni qo‘ying
scenes.say: Navruz is blank March. We have a feast blank 21 March. Many people travel blank Easter.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gap. Har birida to‘g‘ri predlogni tanlang: in, on yoki at. Navro‘z martda. Biz 21 martda dasturxon yozamiz. Ko‘p odamlar Pasxa paytida sayohat qiladi. Javobni ovoz chiqarib to‘liq gap qilib ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Navro‘z martda. Biz 21 martda dasturxon yozamiz. Ko‘p odamlar Pasxa paytida sayohat qiladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Navruz is in March. We have a feast on 21 March. Many people travel at Easter.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “Navruz is in March”, “We have a feast on 21 March”, “Many people travel at Easter”. Birinchisi oy, ikkinchisi aniq sana, uchinchisi bayram davri. Siz to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, bu mavzu sizga tushunarli bo‘ldi. Endi ingliz bayramlari bilan tanishamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Navro‘z martda. Biz 21 martda dasturxon yozamiz. Ko‘p odamlar Pasxa paytida sayohat qiladi.

scenes.title: Rojdestvo Britaniyada

examples.t: Families have a big dinner together.
examples.uz: Oilalar birga katta kechki ovqat qiladi.

examples.t: They wear paper hats.

scenes.say: On Christmas Day families have a big dinner. They often eat roast turkey and wear paper hats from crackers.
scenes.say_native: Britaniyada eng katta bayram — Rojdestvo, 25 dekabr. Oilalar archa bezaydi, tabrik otkrytkalarini yuboradi va sovg‘alar tayyorlaydi. Odatiy bayram tushligi — pishirilgan kurka, ya’ni “roast turkey”. Dasturxonda “crackers” bor: ikki kishi uni tortib ochadi, ichidan qog‘oz qalpoqcha, latifa va kichik sovg‘a chiqadi. Bola-chaqa uchun “Father Christmas” sovg‘a olib keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Rojdestvo kuni oilalar katta kechki ovqat qiladi. Ular ko‘pincha kurka yeydi va krekerlardan chiqqan qog‘oz qalpoq kiyadi.

scenes.title: Boxing Day va Yangi yil

examples.t: 26 December is Boxing Day.
Many people watch fireworks on New Year's Eve.
examples.uz: Ko‘p odamlar Yangi yil arafasida otashbozlik tomosha qiladi.

scenes.say: 26 December is Boxing Day. On New Year's Eve, many people watch fireworks. In Scotland it is called Hogmanay.
scenes.say_native: Rojdestvodan keyingi kun, 26 dekabr, “Boxing Day” deb ataladi va Britaniyada dam olish kuni. Odamlar do‘konlarda chegirmalar bilan xarid qiladi yoki sport tomosha qiladi. Yangi yil arafasi, ya’ni “New Year’s Eve”, 31 dekabr. Shotlandiyada uni “Hogmanay” deyishadi va katta bayram o‘tkazishadi. Bizda esa Yangi yil ko‘pincha eng muhim oilaviy bayramlardan biri, shunday emasmi?
scenes.say_uz: 26 dekabr Boksing Dey. Yangi yil arafasida ko‘p odamlar otashbozlik tomosha qiladi. Shotlandiyada u Hogmanay deb ataladi.

scenes.title: Bonfire Night

examples.t: People light bonfires and watch fireworks.
examples.uz: Odamlar gulxan yoqadi va otashbozlik tomosha qiladi.

scenes.say: On 5 November people light bonfires and watch fireworks. It is called Bonfire Night.
scenes.say_native: Boshqa qiziq bayram — “Bonfire Night”, 5 noyabr. Bu kuni odamlar gulxan yoqadi, otashbozlik tomosha qiladi, bolalar esa “sparklers”, ya’ni yonib turuvchi kichik cho‘plarni ushlaydi. Bayram 1605-yilgi fitna esdaligi bilan bog‘liq, Gay Foks nomi bilan tanilgan. Odamlar tashqarida issiq kiyinib, sovuqda turadi.
scenes.say_uz: 5 noyabrda odamlar gulxan yoqadi va otashbozlik tomosha qiladi. U Bonfire Night deb ataladi.

scenes.title: Halloween va Easter
board: Halloween: 31 October — costumes, pumpkins, trick or treat

examples.t: Children say: trick or treat!
We eat chocolate eggs at Easter.

scenes.say: At Halloween children wear costumes. At Easter they eat chocolate eggs.
scenes.say_native: Halloween — 31 oktyabr. Bolalar kostyum kiyadi, derazalarga o‘yilgan qovoq, ya’ni pumpkin qo‘yiladi, bolalar eshiklarni qoqib “trick or treat” deydi va shirinlik oladi. Pasxa, ya’ni Easter, bahorda keladi: bolalar shokoladli tuxum izlaydi. Pasxadan oldin “Pancake Day” bor, bu kuni inglizlar blin yeydi. Easter Monday — Britaniyada dam olish kuni.
scenes.say_uz: Halloweenda bolalar kostyum kiyadi. Pasxada ular shokoladli tuxum yeydi.

scenes.title: Urf-odatni tasvirlashdagi xato
board: ✗ In Britain people is eat turkey
scenes.say: People celebrate. People give presents. In Britain people eat turkey.
scenes.say_native: Odatni tasvirlaganda Present Simple ishlatamiz: “People give presents”. Muhim xato: “people” so‘zi ko‘plik, shuning uchun “people celebrates” yoki “people is giving” noto‘g‘ri. To‘g‘risi: “people celebrate”, “people give”. Yana ayrim o‘quvchilar “is eat” deb qo‘yadi, chunki “is” ni ortiqcha qo‘shadi. Present Simple’da “is” kerak emas.
scenes.say_uz: Odamlar nishonlaydi. Odamlar sovg‘a beradi. Britaniyada odamlar kurka yeydi.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri yoki noto‘g‘ri
board: 3) At Halloween children say ’trick or treat’.
scenes.say: Christmas Day is 26 December. Bonfire Night is on 5 November. Children say trick or treat at Halloween.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gap. Har biri to‘g‘rimi yoki noto‘g‘rimi, ayting. Birinchisi: Christmas Day 26 dekabr. Ikkinchisi: Bonfire Night 5 noyabrda. Uchinchisi: Halloween’da bolalar “trick or treat” deydi. Noto‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, to‘g‘risini ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Rojdestvo 26 dekabr. Bonfire Night 5 noyabrda. Halloweenda bolalar trick or treat deydi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: False, it is 25 December. True. True.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchisi noto‘g‘ri, Rojdestvo kuni 25 dekabr, 26 dekabr esa Boxing Day. Ikkinchisi to‘g‘ri. Uchinchisi ham to‘g‘ri. Eslatma: ba’zi pravoslav mamlakatlarda Rojdestvo 7 yanvarda nishonlanadi, lekin Britaniyada ham, ko‘p mamlakatlarda ham 25 dekabrda.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri, 25 dekabr. To‘g‘ri. To‘g‘ri.

scenes.title: Bizning bayramlarimiz

examples.t: Navruz is the spring festival.
We cook sumalak and halim.

scenes.say: Navruz is the spring festival on 21 March. Independence Day is on 1 September. Eid is a family holiday.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘z bayramlarimizni inglizcha atashni o‘rganamiz. Navro‘z — “Navruz”, bahor bayrami, 21 mart. Sumalak va halim — shu kunning an’anaviy taomlari, ularni “sumalak” va “halim” deb aytsangiz ham bo‘ladi. Mustaqillik kuni — “Independence Day”, 1 sentyabr. Hayit — “Eid”, Ramazon hayiti va Qurbon hayiti. Yangi yil — “New Year”, 1 yanvar.
scenes.say_uz: Navro‘z — 21 martdagi bahor bayrami. Mustaqillik kuni 1 sentyabrda. Hayit oilaviy bayram.

scenes.title: Bayramni tasvirlash
board: When is it? — It’s on... / in...
What do you eat? — We eat...
How do you feel? — It’s my favourite because...

examples.t: Navruz is in March. People visit friends and relatives.
examples.uz: Navro‘z martda. Odamlar do‘stlar va qarindoshlarni mehmon qiladi.

scenes.say: Navruz is in March. People visit friends and relatives. We cook sumalak. I love it because it is the start of spring.
scenes.say_native: Bayramni tasvirlash uchun to‘rt savolga javob bering. Qachon bo‘ladi? Odamlar nima qiladi? Nima yeyiladi? Nega sizga yoqadi? Masalan: “Navruz is in March. People visit friends and relatives. We cook sumalak. I love it because it is the start of spring”. Mana shu tuzilma sizning uy vazifangiz uchun ham asos bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Navro‘z martda. Odamlar do‘stlar va qarindoshlarni mehmon qiladi. Biz sumalak pishiramiz. Men uni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki u bahor boshlanishi.

scenes.title: O‘xshashlik va farqni aytish

examples.t: Both Navruz and Easter are in spring.
Easter is different from Navruz.

scenes.say: Both Navruz and Easter are in spring. In Britain people eat turkey, while we eat plov.
scenes.say_native: Madaniyatlarni solishtirish uchun yangi iboralar kerak. O‘xshashlik: “both … and”, “similar to”, “the same as”. Farq: “different from”, “but”, “while”. Masalan: “Both Navruz and Easter are in spring”. “In Britain people eat turkey at Christmas, while we eat plov at celebrations”. Bu yerda “while” ikki narsani qarama-qarshi qo‘yadi, ya’ni “esa”.
scenes.say_uz: Navro‘z ham, Pasxa ham bahorda. Britaniyada odamlar kurka yeydi, biz esa palov yeymiz.

scenes.title: Solishtirish xatolari
scenes.say: Easter is different from Navruz. Christmas is similar to New Year. Both are family holidays.
scenes.say_native: Solishtirishda xatolar ko‘p. “Different with” deyish xato, to‘g‘risi “different from”. Britaniyada “different to” ham uchraydi, lekin “from” ishonchli variant. Yana “same like” ham xato, o‘zbekcha “xuddi shunday” ta’siri. To‘g‘risi: “the same as” yoki “similar to”. “Both” bilan esa ko‘plik fe’l: “both are”, “both have”.
scenes.say_uz: Pasxa Navro‘zdan farq qiladi. Rojdestvo Yangi yilga o‘xshaydi. Ikkalasi ham oilaviy bayram.

scenes.title: Solishtiring
scenes.say: Navruz and Easter. Christmas dinner and Eid dinner. Turkey and plov.
scenes.say_native: Uchta juftlik. Birinchi: Navruz va Pasxa — ikkalasi ham bahorda. Ikkinchi: Rojdestvo kechki ovqati va hayit dasturxoni — oilaviy. Uchinchi: Britaniyada kurka, bizda palov. Har juftlik uchun “both”, “similar to” yoki “while” bilan bitta gap ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Navro‘z va Pasxa. Rojdestvo kechki ovqati va hayit dasturxoni. Kurka va palov.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) Both Navruz and Easter are in spring.
2) Christmas dinner is similar to Eid dinner: both are for the family.
3) People eat turkey in Britain, while we eat plov.
scenes.say: Both Navruz and Easter are in spring. Christmas dinner is similar to Eid dinner. People eat turkey in Britain, while we eat plov.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar: “Both Navruz and Easter are in spring”. “Christmas dinner is similar to Eid dinner, because both are for the family”. “People eat turkey in Britain, while we eat plov”. Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi, ikki bayramni o‘rtadagi so‘z bilan bog‘lash. Endi tinglash mashqiga o‘tamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Navro‘z ham, Pasxa ham bahorda. Rojdestvo kechki ovqati hayit dasturxoniga o‘xshaydi. Britaniyada kurka yeyiladi, biz esa palov yeymiz.

scenes.title: Tinglang: Navro‘z haqida
board: Tom: What do you do at Navruz, Dilnoza?
Dilnoza: We cook sumalak and visit our relatives.
Tom: Sounds great! Is it a holiday?
Dilnoza: Yes, it’s a public holiday on 21 March.
Tom: It’s like Easter, then. Both are in spring!
scenes.say: What do you do at Navruz, Dilnoza? We cook sumalak and visit our relatives. Sounds great! Is it a holiday? Yes, it's a public holiday on twenty-first of March. It's like Easter, then. Both are in spring!
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ingliz hamkasb Tom va o‘zbek hamkasbi Dilnoza Navro‘z haqida suhbatlashadi. Tom bayram haqida savol beradi va uni o‘zlarining bayramiga o‘xshatadi. Savollar uchun e’tibor bering: Dilnoza nima pishiradi va bayram qachon?
scenes.say_uz: Dilnoza, Navro‘zda nima qilasiz? Biz sumalak pishiramiz va qarindoshlarni mehmon qilamiz. Ajoyib eshitiladi! Bu dam olish kunimi? Ha, 21 martdagi umumxalq bayrami. Demak, Pasxaga o‘xshaydi. Ikkalasi ham bahorda!

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3) What does Tom compare it to?
scenes.say: What do they cook? When is Navruz? What does Tom compare it to?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: ular nima pishiradi? Ikkinchi: Navro‘z qachon? Uchinchi: Tom bu bayramni nimaga o‘xshatadi? Qisqa va to‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: Ular nima pishiradi? Navro‘z qachon? Tom uni nimaga o‘xshatadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Sumalak. On 21 March. Easter. Sounds great!
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: ular sumalak pishiradi. Navro‘z 21 martda. Tom uni Pasxaga o‘xshatadi, chunki ikkalasi ham bahorda. Dialogda “Sounds great!” iborasini eshitdingiz. Bu — “ajoyib eshitiladi” degani va suhbatdoshning gapiga qiziqish bildirishning oson yo‘li. Uni o‘z nutqingizda ishlating.
scenes.say_uz: Sumalak. 21 martda. Pasxa. Ajoyib eshitiladi!

scenes.title: Bayram tabriklari

examples.t: Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
Eid Mubarak!

scenes.say: Happy New Year! Merry Christmas! Happy Easter! Eid Mubarak! Happy Navruz!
scenes.say_native: Tabriklar. Hamma bayram uchun odatiy shakl: “Happy” va bayram nomi: “Happy New Year”, “Happy Easter”, “Happy Birthday”. Rojdestvo uchun “Merry Christmas” deymiz, Britaniyada “Happy Christmas” ham eshitiladi. Hayit uchun “Eid Mubarak”. Navro‘zni ham “Happy Navruz” deb tabriklash mumkin. Umumiy mavsum tilagi — “Happy holidays”.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi yil bilan! Rojdestvo bilan! Pasxa bilan! Hayitingiz muborak! Navro‘z bilan!

scenes.title: Congratulate xatosi
board: ✗ I congratulate you with the holiday.
scenes.say: Happy New Year! Congratulations on your exam! Congratulations on your new job!
scenes.say_native: Ruscha va o‘zbekcha “bayram bilan tabriklayman” iborasini so‘zma-so‘z o‘girmang. “I congratulate you with the holiday” inglizchada noto‘g‘ri. “Congratulations” yutuq uchun aytiladi: imtihon, to‘y, yangi ish. Bayram uchun esa “Happy” yoki “Merry” ishlatiladi. Shuning uchun Yangi yilga “Happy New Year!” deymiz, “Congratulations!” demaymiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi yil bilan! Imtihon bilan tabriklayman! Yangi ish bilan tabriklayman!

scenes.title: Tabrikka javob
board: Thanks, and the same to you!
Thank you! Happy New Year to you too!

examples.t: Merry Christmas! — You too!

scenes.say: Merry Christmas! Thank you, you too! Happy Easter! Thanks, and the same to you!
scenes.say_native: Tabrik eshitganingizda uni qaytarish kerak. Eng oddiy javob: “Thank you, you too!” yoki “Thanks, and the same to you!”, ya’ni “rahmat, sizni ham”. Kimdir “Merry Christmas” desa, “You too” deysiz. Faqat “Thanks” deyish ham mumkin, lekin tilakni qaytarish iliqroq eshitiladi. Ayniqsa, hamkasblar va qo‘shnilar bilan buni unutmang.
scenes.say_uz: Rojdestvo bilan! Rahmat, sizni ham! Pasxa bilan! Rahmat, sizni ham!

scenes.title: Nima deysiz?
scenes.say: Midnight on 31 December. A friend passes an exam. A neighbour says Happy Navruz.
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyat. Birinchisi: 31 dekabr, yarim tun, hamkasbingizga nima deysiz? Ikkinchisi: do‘stingiz imtihondan o‘tdi, unga nima deysiz? Uchinchisi: qo‘shni sizga “Happy Navruz” dedi, javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: 31 dekabr yarim tun. Do‘st imtihondan o‘tdi. Qo‘shni Happy Navruz dedi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Happy New Year! Congratulations! Thank you, you too!
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: yarim tunda “Happy New Year!”. Imtihon haqida “Congratulations!” yoki “Congratulations on passing your exam!”. Qo‘shniga “Thank you, you too!”. Agar ikkinchi vaziyatda “Happy exam” degan bo‘lsangiz, esda tuting: yutuq uchun “congratulations” ishlatiladi. Uchinchi javobni xuddi shunday boshqa bayramlarga ham qo‘llash mumkin.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi yil bilan! Tabriklayman! Rahmat, sizni ham!

scenes.title: Tabrik kartochkasi
board: Wishing you a happy and healthy year

examples.t: Wishing you a happy and healthy New Year.
examples.uz: Sizga baxtli va sog‘lom Yangi yil tilayman.

scenes.say: Best wishes. Warm wishes. With love. Wishing you a happy and healthy New Year.
scenes.say_native: Tabrik kartochkasi yoki xabarida shunday iboralar ishlatiladi. “Best wishes” — eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, har kimga mos. “Warm wishes” — iliq tilaklar. “With love” faqat yaqinlarga. Uzun tilak: “Wishing you a happy and healthy New Year”. Bunday xabarlar rasmiy emas, ammo xushmuomala. Hamkasbga “Best wishes”, oilangizga “With love” yozing.
scenes.say_uz: Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan. Iliq tilaklar bilan. Sevgi bilan. Sizga baxtli va sog‘lom Yangi yil tilayman.

scenes.title: Tinglang: bayram rejalari
board: Emma: What are you doing for New Year, Aziz?
Aziz: We have a big dinner with the family. Then we watch fireworks.
Emma: Lovely! I usually stay at home. I watch TV.
Aziz: Well, Happy New Year in advance!
Emma: Thanks, and the same to you!
scenes.say: What are you doing for New Year, Aziz? We have a big dinner with the family. Then we watch fireworks. Lovely! I usually stay at home. I watch TV. Well, Happy New Year in advance! Thanks, and the same to you!
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki hamkasb, Emma va Aziz, Yangi yil rejalari haqida gaplashadi. Aziz oila bilan nima qilishini aytadi, Emma esa o‘zining odatini. Dialogda “in advance” iborasi bor, u “oldindan” degani. Oxirgi tabrik va javobga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz, Yangi yilda nima qilasiz? Oila bilan katta kechki ovqat qilamiz. Keyin otashbozlik tomosha qilamiz. Ajoyib! Men odatda uyda qolaman. Televizor ko‘raman. Unda oldindan Yangi yil bilan! Rahmat, sizni ham!

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 3) What does Aziz say at the end?
scenes.say: What does Aziz do first? What does Emma usually do? What does Aziz say at the end?
scenes.say_native: Uch savol. Birinchi: Aziz avval nima qiladi? Ikkinchi: Emma odatda nima qiladi? Uchinchi: Aziz oxirida nima deydi? Qisqa javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz avval nima qiladi? Emma odatda nima qiladi? Aziz oxirida nima deydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) He has a big dinner with his family.
2) She stays at home and watches TV.
scenes.say: He has a big family dinner. She stays at home and watches TV. Happy New Year in advance!
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Aziz avval oilasi bilan katta kechki ovqat qiladi, keyin otashbozlik tomosha qiladi. Emma odatda uyda qoladi va televizor ko‘radi. Oxirida Aziz “Happy New Year in advance!” deydi. Ko‘rdingizmi, ikki madaniyat farq qilsa-da, suhbat do‘stona va iliq. Madaniy farqlar haqida shunday gaplashish yaxshi.
scenes.say_uz: U oilasi bilan katta kechki ovqat qiladi. U uyda qolib televizor ko‘radi. Oldindan Yangi yil bilan!

scenes.title: Bayram haqida savol berish

examples.t: What do people do on Bonfire Night?

scenes.say: Do you celebrate Halloween? What do people do on Bonfire Night? Is it a public holiday?
scenes.say_native: Boshqa madaniyat vakilidan so‘rash uchun foydali savollar: “Do you celebrate Halloween?” — Halloween’ni nishonlaysizmi? “What do people do on Bonfire Night?”. “What do you usually eat?”. “Is it a public holiday?”. Bu savollar Present Simple’da, shuning uchun “do” va “does” kerak. Shaxsiy emas, madaniy savollar berish suhbatni qiziqarli va hurmatli qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Halloween’ni nishonlaysizmi? Bonfire Night’da odamlar nima qiladi? Bu dam olish kunimi?

scenes.title: Ketma-ketlik so‘zlari
board: In the morning / In the evening

examples.t: First we clean the house. Then we cook.
examples.uz: Avval uyni yig‘ishtiramiz. Keyin ovqat pishiramiz.

scenes.say: First we clean the house. Then we cook. After that we visit relatives. Finally we have a big dinner.
scenes.say_native: Bayramda nima qilishingizni tartib bilan aytish uchun bog‘lovchi so‘zlar kerak. “First” — avval, “then” — keyin, “after that” — shundan keyin, “finally” — oxirida. Masalan: “First we clean the house. Then we cook sumalak. After that we visit our relatives. Finally we have a big dinner”. Shu so‘zlar bilan monologingiz tartibli chiqadi.
scenes.say_uz: Avval uyni yig‘ishtiramiz. Keyin ovqat pishiramiz. Shundan keyin qarindoshlarni mehmon qilamiz. Oxirida katta kechki ovqat qilamiz.

scenes.title: Sevimli bayramingiz
board: 1) What is it? When is it?
scenes.say: Tell me about your favourite holiday. When is it? What do people do? Why do you like it?
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Sevimli bayramingiz haqida beshta gap ayting. Birinchi: bu qaysi bayram va qachon? Ikkinchi: odamlar nima qiladi? Uchinchi: nega sizga yoqadi? Bog‘lovchi so‘zlar bilan, tartib bilan gapiring.
scenes.say_uz: Sevimli bayramingiz haqida gapirib bering. U qachon? Odamlar nima qiladi? Nega yoqadi?

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: It is in spring or summer.
First we pray and visit relatives.
I like it because the family is together.
scenes.say: My favourite holiday is Eid. First we visit our parents. Then we have a big dinner. I like it because the whole family is together.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. “My favourite holiday is Eid. First we visit our parents. Then we have a big dinner with relatives. After that we give small gifts to children. I like it because the whole family is together”. Bu javob oddiy, lekin tartibli va sabab bilan tugaydi. Sizning javobingizda ham kamida bitta “because” gapi bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: Mening sevimli bayramim hayit. Avval ota-onamizni ziyorat qilamiz. Keyin katta kechki ovqat qilamiz. Menga yoqadi, chunki butun oila birga bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: Prepositions: on 25 December, in December, at Christmas
scenes.say: We learned holiday words, prepositions, comparisons and greetings. Now you can describe a holiday.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Bayram lug‘atini o‘rgandik: celebrate, tradition, present, fireworks. Predloglar: on sana, in oy, at bayram davri. Britaniya bayramlari: Rojdestvo, Boxing Day, Bonfire Night, Halloween, Easter. O‘z bayramlarimizni inglizcha tasvirladik va solishtirdik. Tabriklar: Happy, Merry, Congratulations faqat yutuq uchun. Javob: you too.
scenes.say_uz: Biz bayram so‘zlari, predloglar, solishtirish va tabriklarni o‘rgandik. Endi bayramni tasvirlay olasiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say: Your homework: write about your favourite holiday and one British holiday. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: sevimli bayramingizni va bitta ingliz bayramini tasvirlab yozing. Jami kamida oltita gap bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: to‘g‘ri predloglar, ketma-ketlik so‘zlari va kamida bitta solishtirish iborasi ishlating, masalan, “both” yoki “while”. Keyingi darsda restoranda menyu va hisob bilan ishlashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: sevimli bayramingiz va bitta ingliz bayrami haqida yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Sevimli bayramingizni va bitta ingliz bayramini tasvirlab, kamida olti gap yozing. To‘g‘ri predloglar (on, in, at), ketma-ketlik so‘zlari va kamida bitta solishtirish iborasi (both yoki while) ishlating.

quiz.q: Choose the correct preposition: We open presents ___ Christmas Day.
quiz.why_uz: Aniq kun bilan on ishlatiladi: on Christmas Day.

quiz.q: Choose the correct preposition: People travel ___ Christmas.
quiz.why_uz: Bayram davri uchun at ishlatiladi: at Christmas.

quiz.q: When is Bonfire Night in Britain?

quiz.why_uz: People ko‘plik, shuning uchun fe’lda s yo‘q.

quiz.q: What do you say to someone at the New Year?
options: I congratulate you with New Year.
quiz.why_uz: Bayram uchun Happy New Year! aytiladi.

options: For an achievement, like passing an exam
quiz.why_uz: Congratulations yutuq uchun, bayram uchun emas.

quiz.q: Someone says 'Merry Christmas!' What is a good reply?

quiz.why_uz: Bank holiday — Britaniyadagi umumxalq dam olish kuni.
Christmas: ch = k, t aytilmaydi, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda.
